findings.current_text: English source: Other. Catch-all for a file the Library could not classify. Singular adjective/noun, not an action. Rendered inside the sentence ui.library.preview.unsupported ONLY via the generic fallback; see manifest.
findings.problem: The pointer "see manifest" has no referent. The only manifest this repo has is the LANGUAGE manifest i18n/languages.json (schema 1: code/native/english/dir/status), and that is exactly what check-coverage.mjs means by "the manifest"; nothing tracked maps a key to the surface it renders on. The substantive half of the sentence is correct — library-viewers.tsx:105-111 renders ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic instead of ui.library.preview.unsupported when kind === "other" — but a translator who follows the pointer finds no mapping to read, and the clause as written can be read as claiming `other` is interpolated into the unsupported sentence, which is the opposite of what the code does.
findings.recommendation: Name the code instead of a non-existent manifest, e.g. "Shown as the badge like every kind; the catch-all preview state swaps in ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic with no kind slot when the kind is `other` (src/renderer/src/features/library/components/library-viewers.tsx)."

per_key_checks.assessment: Accurate and consistent with the corpus's audio noun, not with the plural group label: the catalogue writes ऑडियो for audio files throughout (ui.canvas.json:9 ऑडियो; ui.settings.notifications ऑडियो फ़ाइल; ui.chat.canonical ऑडियो अटैचमेंट). The sibling group label ui.library.category.sounds = आवाज़ें renders English "Sounds", a different English word, and आवाज़ is the corpus's word for voice (ui.settings.speech आवाज़ का ज़रिया) — so the kind/group divergence mirrors the English rather than breaking it. 5 cells against a ~12-cell slot, single noun, no punctuation.

Byte-identical to the shipped group label ui.library.category.code = कोड, which is what the context note asks for ("Not the filter-rail group 'Code' … same word today, independent role"). 3 cells, no punctuation.

Retention judged against the catalogue: no prior DOCX rendering exists to contradict (DOCX appears only in this file), the hi guide keeps product/format names and Latin tokens as-is ("Keep Latin as-is: … product names, tool names"; "Kept-Latin: API, CLI, TUI, JSON, YAML, HTTP, URL"), and the English note declares format names retained technical tokens. The English kind badge is the format id while the group is "Documents" (दस्तावेज़) — the Hindi mirrors that split exactly, so no localized rendering was due here.

Consistent with the existing catalogue, which already writes HTML in Latin inside Hindi prose: ui.canvas.create_file_dialog.html_html = "HTML (.html)", ui.canvas.html_preview.html_preview = "HTML प्रीव्यू: {title}". Localizing it to देवनागरी would contradict seven shipped values. 4 cells.

The singular of the shipped group label ui.library.category.images = तस्वीरें, and the same word the canvas uses for an image (ui.canvas.image_preview.this_image_could_not_be_shown = यह तस्वीर नहीं दिखाई जा सकी), so the "singular of the same word family" requirement holds exactly. 6 cells, one noun.

Kept as the format's proper name, matching the catalogue's existing practice (ui.canvas.create_file_dialog.markdown_md = "Markdown (.md)", plus ui.projects, ui.settings.model, ui.chat.transcript_copy). The hi guide's keep-Latin rule covers it and the English note calls it the format's proper name. 8 cells, the widest Latin token here and still inside the slot.

Identical to ui.library.category.other = अन्य, the same English word in an independent role; a bare adjective used nominally reads correctly as a badge. NOTE: this key also carries finding F1, which is against its English context note, not against this Hindi value. 4 cells.
Latin retained, matching seven shipped values including ui.canvas.pdf_preview.pdf = "PDF: {title}" and "यह PDF नहीं खोली जा सकी". The hi guide keeps format/product names Latin. 3 cells.

Retention justified the same way as DOCX: no prior localized PPTX rendering exists, the English badge names the format rather than the presentation family (group label ui.library.category.presentations = प्रस्तुतियाँ stays for the plural family), and format tokens are kept Latin by the guide. 4 cells.

Byte-identical to ui.library.category.spreadsheets = स्प्रेडशीट (this loan has one form in Hindi, so singular and plural coincide) and to ui.canvas.spreadsheet_preview.spreadsheet_saved = स्प्रेडशीट सहेजी गई. 10 cells, the longest value in the group and still inside the ~12-cell slot.

The corpus's word for plain text: ui.canvas.create_file_dialog.plain_text_txt = "सादा टेक्स्ट (.txt)", and ui.library.preview.pptx_text = टेक्स्ट for the same English "Text" in a different role. 7 cells, no punctuation.
Identical to ui.library.category.video = वीडियो, the singular form of the same word family. 6 cells.

The established rendering: ui.common.models.custom_model = कस्टम मॉडल, ui.settings.appearance.editor.custom_theme = कस्टम थीम, ui.chat.directory.custom_dir = कस्टम डायरेक्टरी. A rail heading, singular, no punctuation, 5 cells.

Keeps the nukta the hi guide requires ("Keep nukta consistently (फ़, ज़, ड़)") and matches the corpus spelling: ui.library.preview.pptx_failed_detail = "… उसका फ़ॉर्मैट इस व्यूअर में नहीं खुलता।" in this same namespace, plus ui.common.actions, ui.settings.model, ui.settings.appearance.editor. 8 cells.
The glossary's recorded rendering (project → प्रोजेक्ट across all seven locales), so no per-locale latitude to diverge. 9 cells, inside the rail slot.

Matches ui.library.filter.source = स्रोत for the same English word. The two headings coexist in one rail, but so do the English ones, and the context note already distinguishes the roles (TAG group vs origin-group filter section); a different word here would break the one-term-one-decision invariant, not fix it. 5 cells.
Matches ui.library.filter.status = स्थिति for the same English word, with the same intentional coexistence as source. 6 cells.

The value the translator flagged, and it is right: it is the catalogue's only existing rendering of "Topic" (ui.teamBridge.create.topic = "विषय (वैकल्पिक)" for "Topic (optional)"), it is the standard Hindi noun for subject matter, and it clashes with nothing else in the rail. Verified in source that it really is the first group (library-model.ts:319 known order starts with "topic"), as the note says. 4 cells, no punctuation.

Standard Hindi for "type" and distinct from the sort option's legacy क़िस्म (ui.library.sort.kind = क़िस्म), which is exactly the distinctness the English note demands ("Keep it distinct from the sort option 'Kind'"). 6 cells.

per_key_checks.source: This file has no in-app preview here.
per_key_checks.current_text: इस फ़ाइल का प्रीव्यू यहाँ ऐप में नहीं दिखता।
per_key_checks.assessment: Meaning preserved with no omission or added polarity: इस फ़ाइल का … नहीं दिखता। = "this file's [preview] does not show", and यहाँ ऐप में carries both "here" and "in-app". It is a clean structural parallel of the shipped ui.library.preview.unsupported = "{kind} फ़ाइल का प्रीव्यू यहाँ ऐप में नहीं दिखता।", so a user sees one sentence pattern whether or not the kind is known; it names no kind (checked mechanically against all 12 kind labels), carries no placeholder, ends with the danda the hi guide requires for prose, and is 44 cells against an English 37 characters for a full-width state line rather than a badge slot. A more formal alternative ("… प्रीव्यू उपलब्ध नहीं है।") is defensible on its own, but parallelism with the sibling sentence is worth more than the register step up, so this is not raised as a finding.
